biography.plain_text: Arthur Laundy is an Australian billionaire publican whose family hotel business is based in Sydney. He inherited his father's pub interests and expanded them into a substantial hospitality group across New South Wales. His children also work in the business, which encompasses neighbourhood pubs, destination venues and larger accommodation hotels.

long_biography.plain_text:
At Laundy Hotels, Arthur Laundy developed an acquisition method built around trading leases, paying down debt and refinancing to buy again. He moved into freehold ownership while keeping close contact with the businesses themselves, visiting managers and talking with customers. As dining became a larger part of pub life, the group's offering expanded beyond the beer and simple snacks of his early working years.

His family entered broadcasting in 2026 by buying Nine's radio businesses through a company under his control. The completed purchase brought commercial radio, live streaming and podcasts into the group's activities. Alongside music stations, the network includes established talkback services reaching audiences in Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane and Perth.
